app.name: Videcook
app.tagline: The easy way to download videos
help.title: How to Use
help.step_1: Install a "Get Cookies" or similar cookie export browser extension.
help.step_2: Open the video you want to download in your browser.
help.step_3: Click the extension icon and use "Export" to save cookies.txt to your computer.
help.step_4: Paste the video link into Videcook.
help.step_5: Select the cookies.txt file you saved.
help.step_6: Choose the folder where the video will be saved.
help.warning_cookie: Your cookie file is never stored. The cookie path is cleared after download completes or is cancelled.
dialog.playlist.title: Playlist detected. What do you want to do?
settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Make sure yt-dlp.exe, ffmpeg.exe, and ffprobe.exe are in the app's bin/ folder.
